comment: Synthetic DSH session logs for lib/host/selftest.mjs. `at` is a LOCAL date-time (no offset) that the builder converts into the event `time` (epoch ms) — this is what makes the fixtures host-time-zone independent. `now` below is the fold anchor.

sessions.covers: two steps/two turns, totalTokens present, cacheReadTokens present, totalTokens missing (input+output fallback), one broken JSONL line, one non-kept event type extending the session span
two raw model ids that both map to label DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (label merge), second step left unclosed (active time only counts closed steps)
unmapped-family model id (deepseek-v4-pro-0801 -> DeepSeek-V4-Pro), different provider
session with steps/turn but no usage at all: must not count towards totals.sessions
usage at 00:30 local — must bucket to the LOCAL calendar day (a UTC bucketing bug would move it to the previous day)
empty (valid zstd) log: tolerated, contributes nothing

sessions.content: this is intentionally not a zstd frame
